records.source: A 58-year-old African-American woman presents to the ER with episodic pressing/burning anterior chest pain that began two days earlier for the first time in her life.
records.translation: 58歳アフリカ系アメリカ人女性。2日前に生来初めて出現した、発作性の前胸部圧迫感・灼熱感を伴う胸痛を主訴に救急外来を受診。
records.back_translation: 58-year-old African-American woman. Came to the emergency outpatient department with chest pain with paroxysmal anterior chest pressure and burning sensation, which appeared for the first time in her life 2 days ago.

records.source: The pain started while she was walking, radiates to the back, and is accompanied by nausea, diaphoresis and mild dyspnea, but is not increased on inspiration.
records.translation: 疼痛は歩行中に出現し、背部への放散を認め、嘔気、発汗、軽度の呼吸困難を伴うが、吸気時の増悪はない。
records.back_translation: The pain appeared while walking, radiates to the back, and is accompanied by nausea, sweating and mild dyspnoea, but there is no worsening on inspiration.

records.source: The latest episode of pain ended half an hour prior to her arrival.
records.translation: 直近の胸痛発作は来院30分前に消失している。
records.back_translation: The most recent chest pain attack had resolved 30 minutes before arrival at hospital.

records.source: She is known to have hypertension and obesity.
records.translation: 高血圧および肥満の既往あり。
records.back_translation: History of hypertension and obesity.

records.source: She denies smoking, diabetes, hypercholesterolemia, or a family history of heart disease.
records.translation: 喫煙歴、糖尿病、高コレステロール血症、心疾患の家族歴はいずれも否定。
records.back_translation: Smoking history, diabetes, hypercholesterolaemia and family history of heart disease are all denied.

records.source: She currently takes no medications.
records.translation: 現在、内服薬なし。
records.back_translation: Currently no oral medications.

records.source: Physical examination is normal.
records.translation: 身体所見に異常なし。
records.back_translation: No abnormality on physical findings.

records.source: The EKG shows nonspecific changes.
records.translation: 心電図では非特異的変化を認める。
records.back_translation: The ECG shows nonspecific changes.

records.source: The patient will provide informed consent, and will comply with the trial protocol without any practical issues.
records.translation: 本人よりインフォームド・コンセントが得られる見込みであり、治験実施計画書を実務上の問題なく遵守可能である。
records.back_translation: It is expected that informed consent will be obtained from the patient, and the patient is able to comply with the trial protocol without practical problems.
records.what_differs: 'will provide informed consent' becomes 'consent is expected to be obtained' (見込み), and 'will comply' becomes 'is able to comply'; the source states both as given
records.proposed_correction: 本人はインフォームド・コンセントを提供し、治験実施計画書を実務上の問題なく遵守する。

records.source: An 8-year-old male presents in March to the ER with fever up to 39 C, dyspnea and cough for 2 days.
records.translation: 8歳男児。3月、最高39℃の発熱、呼吸困難、咳嗽が2日間持続し救急外来を受診。
records.back_translation: 8-year-old boy. In March, fever up to 39 °C, dyspnoea and cough persisting for 2 days; came to the emergency outpatient department.

records.source: He has just returned from a 5 day vacation in Colorado.
records.translation: コロラド州での5日間の休暇から戻ったばかりである。
records.back_translation: He has just come back from a 5-day holiday in the State of Colorado.

records.source: Parents report that prior to the onset of fever and cough, he had loose stools.
records.translation: 両親によると、発熱・咳嗽の出現前に軟便があったとのこと。
records.back_translation: According to the parents, there were soft stools before the fever and cough appeared.

records.source: He denies upper respiratory tract symptoms.
records.translation: 上気道症状は否定。
records.back_translation: Upper airway symptoms are denied.

records.source: On examination he is in respiratory distress and has bronchial respiratory sounds on the left.
records.translation: 診察上、呼吸窮迫状態であり、左側で気管支呼吸音を聴取する。
records.back_translation: On examination, he is in respiratory distress, and bronchial breath sounds are heard on the left side.

records.source: A chest x-ray shows bilateral lung infiltrates.
records.translation: 胸部X線写真で両側肺浸潤影を認める。
records.back_translation: Chest X-ray shows bilateral lung infiltrative shadows.

records.back_translation: It is expected that informed consent will be obtained from the patient, and the patient is able to comply with the trial protocol without practical problems.

records.source: A 58-year-old nonsmoker white female with mild exertional dyspnea and occasional cough is found to have a left lung mass on chest x-ray.
records.translation: 58歳非喫煙者の白人女性。軽度の労作時呼吸困難と時折の咳嗽があり、胸部X線写真で左肺腫瘤を指摘された。

records.source: She is otherwise asymptomatic.

records.back_translation: Otherwise asymptomatic.

records.source: A 2-year-old boy is brought to the emergency department by his parents for 5 days of high fever and irritability.
records.translation: 2歳男児。5日間持続する高熱と不機嫌を主訴に両親に連れられ救急外来を受診。
records.back_translation: 2-year-old boy. Brought by his parents to the emergency outpatient department with high fever and irritability lasting 5 days.

records.source: The physical exam reveals conjunctivitis, strawberry tongue, inflammation of the hands and feet, desquamation of the skin of the fingers and toes, and cervical lymphadenopathy with the smallest node at 1.5 cm.
records.translation: 身体所見では結膜炎、いちご舌、手足の炎症、手指・足趾の皮膚落屑、および頸部リンパ節腫脹（最小のリンパ節で1.5 cm）を認める。
records.back_translation: Physical findings show conjunctivitis, strawberry tongue, inflammation of hands and feet, desquamation of the skin of fingers and toes, and cervical lymph node swelling (1.5 cm at the smallest node).

records.source: The abdominal exam demonstrates tenderness and enlarged liver.
records.translation: 腹部診察では圧痛および肝腫大を認める。
records.back_translation: Abdominal examination shows tenderness and hepatomegaly.

records.source: Laboratory tests report elevated alanine aminotransferase, white blood cell count of 17,580/mm, albumin 2.1 g/dL, C-reactive protein 4.5 mg, erythrocyte sedimentation rate 60 mm/h, mild normochromic, normocytic anemia, and leukocytes in urine of 20/mL with no bacteria identified.
records.translation: 血液検査ではALT上昇、白血球数17,580/mm、アルブミン2.1 g/dL、CRP 4.5 mg、赤沈60 mm/h、軽度の正色素性正球性貧血を認め、尿中白血球20/mLで細菌は検出されず。
records.back_translation: Blood tests show raised ALT, white cell count 17,580/mm, albumin 2.1 g/dL, CRP 4.5 mg, ESR 60 mm/h, mild normochromic normocytic anaemia; urine white cells 20/mL with no bacteria detected.

records.source: The echocardiogram shows moderate dilation of the coronary arteries with possible coronary artery aneurysm.
records.translation: 心エコーで冠動脈の中等度拡張を認め、冠動脈瘤の可能性あり。
records.back_translation: Cardiac echo shows moderate dilatation of the coronary arteries, with possible coronary aneurysm.

records.source: A 56-year-old female on 20th day post-left mastectomy presents to the emergency department complaining of shortness of breath and malaise.
records.translation: 56歳女性。左乳房切除術後20日目、息切れと倦怠感を主訴に救急外来を受診。
records.back_translation: 56-year-old woman. Day 20 after left mastectomy; came to the emergency outpatient department with shortness of breath and malaise.

records.source: The patient says that she has remained in bed for the last two weeks.
records.translation: 本人によると、この2週間はずっと臥床していたとのこと。
records.back_translation: According to her, she has been lying in bed the whole time for these 2 weeks.

records.source: The physical examination reveals tenderness on the left upper thoracic wall and right calf.
records.translation: 身体所見では左上胸壁および右腓腹部に圧痛を認める。
records.back_translation: Physical findings show tenderness at the left upper chest wall and the right calf.

records.source: The surgical incision shows no bleeding or signs of infection.
records.translation: 手術創に出血や感染徴候は認めない。
records.back_translation: No bleeding or signs of infection at the surgical wound.

records.translation: 肺聴診で両側の呼吸音減弱を認め、特に右肺底部で顕著。
records.back_translation: Lung auscultation shows bilateral reduced breath sounds, particularly marked at the right lung base.

records.back_translation: Blood tests show raised D-dimer.

records.source: 64-year-old obese female with diagnosis of diabetes mellitus and persistently elevated HbA1c.
records.translation: 64歳肥満女性。糖尿病と診断されており、HbA1cが持続的に高値。
records.back_translation: 64-year-old obese woman. Diagnosed with diabetes; HbA1c persistently high.

records.source: She is reluctant to see a nutritionist and is not compliant with her diabetes medication or exercise.
records.translation: 栄養士の指導を受けることに消極的で、糖尿病治療薬の服薬および運動療法のアドヒアランス不良。
records.back_translation: She is reluctant to receive dietitian guidance, and adherence to diabetes medication and exercise therapy is poor.

records.translation: 左下腿の有痛性皮膚病変を訴える。
records.back_translation: Complains of a painful skin lesion on the left lower leg.

records.source: She has tried using topical lotions and creams but the lesion has increased in size and is now oozing.
records.translation: 外用ローションやクリームを使用したが、病変は拡大し、現在は滲出を伴っている。
records.back_translation: Used topical lotions and creams, but the lesion has enlarged and is now accompanied by exudation.

records.source: A 26-year-old obese woman with a history of bipolar disorder complains that her recent struggles with her weight and eating have caused her to feel depressed.
records.translation: 26歳肥満女性、双極性障害の既往あり。最近の体重や食行動の問題により抑うつ気分を感じていると訴える。
records.back_translation: 26-year-old obese woman with a history of bipolar disorder. Complains of feeling depressed because of recent problems with weight and eating behaviour.

records.source: She states that she has recently had difficulty sleeping and feels excessively anxious and agitated.
records.translation: 最近は睡眠困難があり、過度の不安感と焦燥感を自覚しているとのこと。
records.back_translation: Recently has difficulty sleeping and is aware of excessive anxiety and agitation.

records.source: She also states that she has had thoughts of suicide.
records.translation: 希死念慮もあったと述べている。
records.back_translation: She states that she also had a wish to die (passive death wish).

records.proposed_correction: 自殺念慮もあったと述べている。

records.source: She often finds herself fidgety and unable to sit still for extended periods of time.

records.back_translation: She is often restless and cannot sit still for long periods.

records.back_translation: Her family points out that her irritability is increasing.

records.source: A 62-year-old man sees a neurologist for progressive memory loss and jerking movements of the lower extremities.
records.translation: 62歳男性。進行性の記憶障害と下肢のミオクローヌス様不随意運動を主訴に神経内科を受診。
records.back_translation: 62-year-old man. Came to neurology with progressive memory impairment and myoclonus-like involuntary movements of the lower limbs.

records.source: A physician is called to see a 67-year-old woman who underwent cardiac catheterization via the right femoral artery earlier in the morning.
records.translation: 本日午前に右大腿動脈アプローチで心臓カテーテル検査を受けた67歳女性について、医師が診察を依頼された。
records.back_translation: A doctor was asked to examine a 67-year-old woman who had cardiac catheterisation via a right femoral artery approach this morning.

records.source: She is now complaining of a cool right foot.
records.translation: 現在、右足の冷感を訴えている。
records.back_translation: Now complains of coldness of the right foot.

records.source: Upon examination she has a pulsatile mass in her right groin with loss of distal pulses, and auscultation reveals a bruit over the point at which the right femoral artery was entered.
records.translation: 診察上、右鼡径部に拍動性腫瘤を認め、末梢動脈の拍動は消失しており、聴診で右大腿動脈穿刺部に血管雑音を聴取する。
records.back_translation: On examination, a pulsatile mass in the right groin; peripheral arterial pulses are lost; on auscultation a vascular bruit is heard at the right femoral artery puncture site.

records.source: A 40-year-old woman with no past medical history presents to the ER with excruciating pain in her right arm that had started 1 hour prior to her admission.
records.translation: 既往歴のない40歳女性。来院1時間前に発症した右上肢の激痛を主訴に救急外来を受診。
records.back_translation: 40-year-old woman with no past history. Came to the emergency outpatient department with severe pain in the right upper limb that began 1 hour before arrival at hospital.
records.what_differs: anchor 'prior to her admission' becomes 'before arrival at hospital' (来院前)
records.proposed_correction: 既往歴のない40歳女性。入院1時間前に発症した右上肢の激痛を主訴に救急外来を受診。

records.source: She denies trauma.
records.translation: 外傷は否定。
records.back_translation: Trauma is denied.

records.source: On examination she is pale and in moderate discomfort, as well as tachypneic and tachycardic.
records.translation: 診察上、顔面蒼白で中等度の苦悶様であり、頻呼吸および頻脈を認める。
records.back_translation: On examination, pale face, moderately distressed, with tachypnoea and tachycardia.

records.source: Her body temperature is normal and her blood pressure is 80/60.
records.translation: 体温は正常、血圧80/60。
records.back_translation: Body temperature normal, blood pressure 80/60.

records.source: Her right arm has no discoloration or movement limitation.

records.translation: 36歳女性。12週間の無月経、昨日から増量している少量の性器出血、下腹部圧痛、嘔気・嘔吐を主訴に救急外来を受診。
records.back_translation: 36-year-old woman. Came to the emergency outpatient department with amenorrhoea for 12 weeks, small genital bleeding increasing since yesterday, lower abdominal tenderness, nausea and vomiting.

records.source: The physical exam reveals overall tender abdomen, 18-week sized uterus, and cervical dilation of 2 cm.
records.translation: 身体所見では腹部全体の圧痛、妊娠18週相当の子宮腫大、子宮頸管2 cm開大を認める。

records.back_translation: Blood count and biochemistry normal.

records.back_translation: Point-of-care pregnancy test with cut-off sensitivity 25 mIU/ml beta-hCG negative.

records.translation: 28歳女性。野良動物保護キャンペーンに参加したカリフォルニア旅行から戻って3週間後に、頸部・肩の痛みと左手・左上肢の異常感覚が出現。

records.source: Her physical exam was unremarkable except for slight tremors and almost imperceptible spasticity.
records.translation: 身体所見ではわずかな振戦とほとんど気付かない程度の痙縮以外に異常はなかった。
records.back_translation: Physical findings: no abnormality apart from slight tremor and barely noticeable spasticity.

records.back_translation: 21-year-old woman. Came for work-up of progressive joint pain and malaise.

records.translation: 15歳女性。腹痛を主訴に救急外来を受診。
records.back_translation: 15-year-old female. Came to the emergency outpatient department with abdominal pain.

records.proposed_correction: 15歳女子。腹痛を主訴に救急外来を受診。

records.source: The pain appeared gradually and was periumbilical at first, localizing to the right lower quadrant over hours.
records.translation: 疼痛は緩徐に出現し、当初は臍周囲であったが、数時間かけて右下腹部に限局した。

records.translation: 昨日から食欲がないが、下痢は否定。
records.back_translation: No appetite since yesterday, but diarrhoea denied.

records.back_translation: 33-year-old male athlete. Came to the emergency department with acute abdominal pain.

records.translation: 家族によると、1週間前に自転車から転落して左半腹部を鈍的に打撲し、同日以降軽度の腹痛が続いていたとのこと。

records.back_translation: Pale face; abdominal examination showed muscular guarding and resistance.

records.back_translation: 8-year-old boy. Fell from a bicycle and struck the left temporal region on the road surface.

records.source: There was no immediate loss of consciousness, and a brief examination at the scene noted his pupils were symmetrical, reactive to the light, and he was moving all four limbs.
records.translation: 受傷直後の意識消失はなく、現場での簡易診察では瞳孔は左右対称で対光反射あり、四肢の動きも認められた。
records.back_translation: No loss of consciousness immediately after the injury; on a brief examination at the scene, pupils equal, light reflex present, and movement of all four limbs seen.

records.source: Half an hour after the fall the child became drowsy, pale, and vomited.
records.translation: 受傷30分後、傾眠、顔面蒼白、嘔吐が出現した。
records.back_translation: 30 minutes after the injury, somnolence, pale face and vomiting appeared.

records.source: He was transferred to the emergency department.
records.translation: 救急外来へ搬送された。
records.back_translation: He was transported to the emergency department.

records.back_translation: On arrival, heart rate 52/min, blood pressure 155/98.

records.back_translation: Glasgow Coma Scale (GCS) 6/15, unequal pupils, and motor impairment of the right upper and lower limbs.

records.translation: 脳神経外科チームは、CT検査を延期し直ちに治療を開始するよう助言した。

records.back_translation: 21-year-old male university student. Undergoes colonoscopy because of a family history of multiple polyps in his older brother and older sister.

records.source: His brother underwent total proctocolectomy at age 22, and his sister underwent a total proctocolectomy at age 28, after both were found to have hundreds of colonic adenomas on colonoscopy.
records.translation: 兄は22歳時、姉は28歳時に大腸全摘術を受けており、両者とも大腸内視鏡検査で数百個の大腸腺腫を指摘されていた。
records.back_translation: His older brother at 22 and his older sister at 28 had total colectomy; both had been found to have hundreds of colonic adenomas on colonoscopy.

records.source: Both siblings are currently well without any findings of neoplasms.
records.translation: 両者とも現在は経過良好で、腫瘍性病変の所見は認めない。
records.back_translation: Both are currently doing well, with no findings of neoplastic lesions.

records.back_translation: He had sigmoidoscopy, and dozens of small colonic polyps were found in the rectosigmoid.

records.source: Several of these are biopsied and are all benign adenomas.
records.translation: そのうち数個を生検し、すべて良性腺腫であった。

records.back_translation: Over this 1 month, blood pressure, previously controlled with diltiazem, hydrochlorothiazide and propranolol, has worsened.

records.translation: 82歳女性。朝、左肩および顎へ放散する刺すような胸骨下の胸痛で目覚め、胸痛と息切れのため救急外来を受診。
records.back_translation: 82-year-old woman. In the morning she woke with stabbing substernal chest pain radiating to the left shoulder and jaw, and came to the emergency department because of chest pain and shortness of breath.

records.source: The patient had hypertension, renal-artery stenosis with chronic renal insufficiency, hypercholesterolemia, osteoporosis and dementia.
records.translation: 既往歴として高血圧、慢性腎不全を伴う腎動脈狭窄症、高コレステロール血症、骨粗鬆症、認知症があった。
records.back_translation: Past history: hypertension, renal artery stenosis with chronic renal failure, hypercholesterolaemia, osteoporosis, dementia.

records.source: Blood pressure was 199/108 mm Hg, respiratory rate 18 bpm, oxygen saturation 98% on ambient air.
records.translation: 血圧199/108 mm Hg、呼吸数18 bpm、室内気で酸素飽和度98%。
records.back_translation: Blood pressure 199/108 mm Hg, respiratory rate 18 bpm, oxygen saturation 98% on room air.

records.source: The heart sounds were rapid and with no murmurs.
records.translation: 心音は頻拍であり、心雑音は聴取しなかった。
records.back_translation: Heart sounds were tachycardic, and no murmur was heard.

records.source: CK-MB was 10.9 ng/ml, CK was 89 U/l, CK index was 12.2% and Troponin T was 0.40 ng/ml.
records.translation: CK-MB 10.9 ng/ml、CK 89 U/l、CKインデックス12.2%、トロポニンT 0.40 ng/ml。
records.back_translation: CK-MB 10.9 ng/ml, CK 89 U/l, CK index 12.2%, troponin T 0.40 ng/ml.

records.source: An EKG showed sinus regular tachycardia of 119 bpm, with ST-segment elevations up to 3 mm in V1, V2, and V3.
records.translation: 心電図で心拍数119 bpmの洞性頻脈を認め、V1、V2、V3で最大3 mmのST上昇を認めた。
records.back_translation: ECG showed sinus tachycardia with heart rate 119 bpm, and ST elevation of up to 3 mm in V1, V2 and V3.
records.what_differs: 'regular' is dropped from 'sinus regular tachycardia'
records.proposed_correction: 心電図で心拍数119 bpmの規則的な洞性頻脈を認め、V1、V2、V3で最大3 mmのST上昇を認めた。

records.source: A chest radiograph showed low lung volumes and right basilar subsegmental atelectasis.
records.translation: 胸部X線写真で肺容量の低下と右肺底部の亜区域性無気肺を認めた。
records.back_translation: Chest X-ray showed reduced lung volume and subsegmental atelectasis at the right lung base.

records.source: Coronary angiography showed no stenosis or clinically significant disease.
records.translation: 冠動脈造影では狭窄や臨床的に有意な病変は認めなかった。
records.back_translation: Coronary angiography showed no stenosis or clinically significant lesion.

records.source: Left ventriculography revealed akinesis of the anterior wall, hypokinesis of the apical and distal inferior walls, and compensatory hyperkinesis of the basal anterior and basal inferior walls.
records.translation: 左室造影で前壁の無収縮、心尖部および下壁遠位部の収縮低下、前壁基部および下壁基部の代償性過収縮を認めた。
records.back_translation: Left ventriculography showed akinesis of the anterior wall, hypokinesis of the apex and distal inferior wall, and compensatory hyperkinesis of the basal anterior and basal inferior walls.

records.source: A transthoracic echocardiogram showed severe segmental left ventricular dysfunction involving the septum, anteroseptal territory, and apex.
records.translation: 経胸壁心エコーで中隔、前壁中隔領域、心尖部に及ぶ高度の局所性左室機能障害を認めた。
records.back_translation: Transthoracic echo showed severe regional left ventricular dysfunction extending to the septum, anteroseptal territory and apex.

records.source: The overall left ventricular systolic function was mildly impaired and there was mild mitral regurgitation.
records.translation: 左室収縮能は全体として軽度低下しており、軽度の僧帽弁逆流を認めた。
records.back_translation: Overall left ventricular systolic function was mildly reduced, with mild mitral regurgitation.

records.source: For the past several days she has had pain, swelling and stiffness in her knees, hips and right elbow.
records.translation: ここ数日は両膝、両股関節、右肘の疼痛、腫脹、こわばりを認める。
records.back_translation: In the last few days, pain, swelling and stiffness of both knees, both hips and the right elbow.

records.source: She also reports intermittent fevers ranging from 38.2 to 39.4 degrees Celsius and chest pain.

records.translation: 精査で軽度の鉄欠乏を認める。

records.translation: 産科医が2週間後に血算を再検した。
records.back_translation: The obstetrician repeated the blood count 2 weeks later.

records.source: The Hb is 8.9 g/dL, WBC count 7.1 x 109/L, and platelets 108 x 109/L.

records.translation: Karenさん（72歳女性）は高血圧と2型糖尿病があり、2週間前に潜因性脳卒中で入院した。
records.back_translation: Karen (72-year-old woman) has hypertension and type 2 diabetes, and was admitted 2 weeks ago with cryptogenic stroke.

records.source: At the time, computed tomography was negative for brain hemorrhage and she was given thrombolytic therapy with resolution of her symptoms.
records.translation: 当時、CTで脳出血は否定され、血栓溶解療法を受けて症状は消失した。
records.back_translation: At that time, brain haemorrhage was ruled out on CT; she had thrombolytic therapy and the symptoms resolved.

records.translation: 経食道心エコーおよび脳・大血管のMRアンギオグラフィーでは異常所見を認めなかった。
records.back_translation: Transoesophageal echo and MR angiography of brain and great vessels showed no abnormal findings.

records.back_translation: Now blood pressure 120/70 mm Hg, blood glucose normal, normal sinus rhythm on 12-lead ECG.

records.source: She reports history of occasional palpitations, shortness of breath and chest pain lasting for a few minutes and then stopping on their own.
records.translation: 数分間持続して自然に消失する動悸、息切れ、胸痛が時々あったと述べている。
records.back_translation: She states that she had occasional palpitations, shortness of breath and chest pain lasting a few minutes and resolving spontaneously.

records.source: A 4 year old boy presents to the emergency room with wheezing.
records.translation: 4歳男児。喘鳴を主訴に救急外来を受診。
records.back_translation: 4-year-old boy. Came to the emergency department with wheeze.

records.source: He has had a history of allergic rhinitis, but no history of wheezing.
records.translation: アレルギー性鼻炎の既往はあるが、喘鳴の既往はない。
records.back_translation: History of allergic rhinitis but no history of wheeze.

records.translation: 母親によると、5時間前に裏庭の砂場で遊んでいた際、突然咳き込み始めたのを聞いたとのこと。
records.back_translation: According to his mother, 5 hours ago while playing in the backyard sandpit, she heard him suddenly start coughing.

records.source: The coughing lasted only moments, but he has been audibly wheezing since.
records.translation: 咳嗽はほんの短時間で治まったが、それ以降、聴取可能な喘鳴が続いている。
records.back_translation: The cough settled in a very short time, but since then an audible wheeze has continued.

records.source: Mother was concerned, because his breathing has not returned to normal, so she brought him to the ED.
records.translation: 呼吸が元に戻らないため心配した母親が救急外来に連れて来た。
records.back_translation: Worried because his breathing did not return to normal, the mother brought him to the emergency department.

records.source: On exam, the child is playful and well appearing.
records.translation: 診察上、児は機嫌良く、全身状態は良好である。
records.back_translation: On examination, the child is in a good mood, and general condition is good.

records.source: Wheezing is heard in the mid-right chest area.
records.translation: 右中胸部に喘鳴を聴取する。
records.back_translation: Wheeze heard in the right mid-chest.

records.source: O2 sats are 100% on room air.
records.translation: 室内気でSpO2 100%。
records.back_translation: SpO2 100% on room air.

records.source: She reports no complaints and is in general good health.

records.source: A 65 yo African-American male with shortness of breath related to exertion that has been worsening over the past three weeks.
records.translation: 65歳アフリカ系アメリカ人男性。過去3週間で増悪している労作時息切れ。
records.back_translation: 65-year-old African-American man. Exertional shortness of breath worsening over the past 3 weeks.

records.source: He also has difficulty breathing when lying flat and has started using two to three extra pillows at night.
records.translation: 臥位での呼吸困難もあり、夜間は枕を2〜3個追加して使用するようになった。
records.back_translation: Also dyspnoea when lying down; at night has started using 2-3 extra pillows.

records.source: Significant physical exam findings include bibasilar lung crackles, pitting ankle edema and jugular venous distension.

records.back_translation: Main physical findings: crackles at both lung bases, pitting ankle oedema, jugular venous distension.

records.translation: 多量の喫煙歴があり、過去2年間慢性咳嗽のある66歳女性。最近進行する息切れを主訴に受診。
records.back_translation: 66-year-old woman with heavy smoking history and chronic cough for the past 2 years. Came with recently progressing shortness of breath.

records.source: She is in moderate respiratory distress after walking from the waiting room to the examination room.
records.translation: 待合室から診察室まで歩いた後、中等度の呼吸窮迫状態にある。
records.back_translation: After walking from the waiting room to the examination room, she is in moderate respiratory distress.

records.source: Physical exam reveals mildly distended neck veins, a barrel-shaped chest, and moderate inspiratory and expiratory wheezes.
records.translation: 身体所見では軽度の頸静脈怒張、樽状胸郭、中等度の吸気・呼気時喘鳴を認める。
records.back_translation: Physical findings: mild jugular venous distension, barrel chest, moderate inspiratory and expiratory wheeze.

records.source: She has smoked 1 to 2 packs per days for the past 47 years.
records.translation: 過去47年間、1日1〜2箱喫煙している。
records.back_translation: For the past 47 years she has smoked 1-2 packs a day.

records.source: An 89-year-old man was brought to the emergency department by his wife and son after six months of progressive changes in cognition and personality.
records.translation: 89歳男性。6か月間にわたる進行性の認知機能および人格の変化のため、妻と息子に連れられて救急外来を受診した。
records.back_translation: 89-year-old man. Brought by his wife and son to the emergency department because of progressive changes in cognitive function and personality over 6 months.

records.source: He began to have poor memory, difficulty expressing himself, and exhibited unusual behaviors, such as pouring milk onto the table and undressing immediately after getting dressed.
records.translation: 記憶力低下と言語表出困難が出現し、テーブルに牛乳を注ぐ、服を着た直後に脱ぐといった異常行動がみられた。
records.back_translation: Memory decline and difficulty with verbal expression appeared, and abnormal behaviour was seen, such as pouring milk on the table and undressing right after dressing.

records.source: He is unable to dress, bathe, use the toilet, or walk independently.
records.translation: 自力での更衣、入浴、排泄、歩行ができない。
records.back_translation: Cannot dress, bathe, toilet or walk by himself.

records.source: On examination the patient's temperature was 36.5C (97.7F), the heart rate 61 bpm in an irregular rhythm, the blood pressure 144/78 mm Hg, and the respiratory rate 18 bpm.
records.translation: 診察時、体温36.5℃（97.7°F）、心拍数61 bpmで不整、血圧144/78 mm Hg、呼吸数18 bpmであった。
records.back_translation: On examination, temperature 36.5 °C (97.7 °F), heart rate 61 bpm and irregular, blood pressure 144/78 mm Hg, respiratory rate 18 bpm.

records.source: The patient was alert and oriented to self and city but not year.
records.translation: 意識清明で、自己および場所（市）の見当識は保たれていたが、年の見当識は障害されていた。
records.back_translation: Alert; orientation to self and place (city) preserved, but orientation to year impaired.

records.source: He frequently interrupted the examiner.
records.translation: 診察者の話を頻繁に遮った。
records.back_translation: He frequently interrupted the examiner.

records.source: He repeatedly reached out to grab things in front of him, including the examiner's tie and face.
records.translation: 診察者のネクタイや顔を含め、目の前の物に繰り返し手を伸ばしてつかもうとした。
records.back_translation: He repeatedly reached out to grab things in front of him, including the examiner's tie and face.

records.source: He could not spell the word "world" backward, could not follow commands involving multiple steps and was unable to perform simple calculations.
records.translation: 「world」の逆唱ができず、多段階の指示に従えず、簡単な計算もできなかった。
records.back_translation: Could not say "world" backwards, could not follow multi-step instructions, and could not do simple calculations.

records.source: His speech was fluent, but he often used similar-sounding word substitutions.
records.translation: 発語は流暢であったが、音の似た語への置換が頻繁にみられた。
records.back_translation: Speech was fluent, but substitution with similar-sounding words was frequent.

records.source: He could immediately recall three out of three words but recalled none of them after 5 minutes.
records.translation: 3語の即時再生は3/3可能であったが、5分後の遅延再生は0/3であった。
records.back_translation: Immediate recall of 3 words was 3/3, but delayed recall after 5 minutes was 0/3.

records.source: Examination of the cranial nerves revealed clinically significant paratonic rigidity.
records.translation: 脳神経の診察で臨床的に有意なパラトニア性固縮を認めた。
records.back_translation: Cranial nerve examination showed clinically significant paratonic rigidity.

records.source: Myoclonic jerks were seen in the arms, with symmetrically brisk reflexes.
records.translation: 両上肢にミオクローヌスを認め、腱反射は左右対称に亢進していた。
records.back_translation: Myoclonus in both upper limbs; tendon reflexes symmetrically increased.

records.source: The reflexes in the legs were normal.
records.translation: 下肢の腱反射は正常であった。
records.back_translation: Tendon reflexes of the lower limbs were normal.

records.translation: 32歳男性。下痢、腹部痙攣痛、鼓腸を主訴に外来を受診。
records.back_translation: 32-year-old man. Came to outpatients with diarrhoea, crampy abdominal pain and flatulence.

records.source: Stools are greasy and foul-smelling.
records.translation: 便は脂肪性で悪臭を伴う。
records.back_translation: Stools are fatty and foul-smelling.

records.source: He also has loss of appetite and malaise.
records.translation: 食欲不振と倦怠感もある。
records.back_translation: Also loss of appetite and malaise.

records.source: He recently returned home from a hiking trip in the mountains where he drank water from natural sources.
records.translation: 最近山岳ハイキングから帰宅したばかりで、その際に自然の水源の水を飲用した。
records.back_translation: Has just come home from mountain hiking, during which he drank water from natural sources.

records.translation: ヨード染色便塗抹標本で、平滑で明瞭な壁と2個以上の核を有する楕円形のシストを認めた。
records.back_translation: Iodine-stained stool smear showed oval cysts with smooth, clear walls and 2 or more nuclei.

records.translation: 結核の既往のある65歳男性。血痰の混じる湿性咳嗽を訴えるようになった。
records.back_translation: 65-year-old man with a history of tuberculosis. Has begun to complain of productive cough with blood-mixed sputum.

records.source: Chest X-ray reveals a round opaque mass within a cavity in his left upper lobe.
records.translation: 胸部X線写真で左上葉の空洞内に円形の不透過性腫瘤を認める。
records.back_translation: Chest X-ray shows a round radio-opaque mass inside a cavity in the left upper lobe.

records.source: The spherical mass moved in the cavity during supine and prone CT imaging.
records.translation: 仰臥位および腹臥位のCTで、球状の腫瘤が空洞内を移動した。
records.back_translation: On supine and prone CT, the spherical mass moved within the cavity.

records.source: Culture of the sputum revealed an organism with septated, low-angle branching hyphae that had straight, parallel walls.
records.translation: 喀痰培養で、平行で直線的な壁を有し、鋭角に分岐する隔壁のある菌糸を持つ微生物が検出された。
records.back_translation: Sputum culture detected an organism with septate hyphae that branch at acute angles, with parallel straight walls.

records.translation: 血算で白血球減少、ヘマトクリット上昇、血小板減少を認める。
records.back_translation: Blood count shows low white cells, raised haematocrit, low platelets.

records.translation: 特記すべき既往のない31歳男性。湿性咳嗽と胸痛を主訴に受診。
records.back_translation: 31-year-old man with no notable past history. Came with productive cough and chest pain.

records.source: He reports developing cold symptoms one week ago that were improving until two days ago, when he developed a new fever, chills, and worsening cough.
records.translation: 1週間前に感冒症状が出現し改善傾向にあったが、2日前から新たな発熱、悪寒、咳嗽の増悪が出現した。
records.back_translation: Common-cold symptoms appeared 1 week ago and were improving, but from 2 days ago new fever, chills and worsening cough appeared.

records.source: He has right-sided chest pain that is aggravated by coughing.
records.translation: 咳嗽で増悪する右胸痛がある。
records.back_translation: Right chest pain worsening with coughing.

records.source: His wife also had cold symptoms a week ago but is now feeling well.
records.translation: 妻も1週間前に感冒症状があったが、現在は回復している。
records.back_translation: His wife also had cold symptoms 1 week ago, but has now recovered.

records.source: Vitals signs include temperature 103.4, pulse 105, blood pressure 120/80, and respiratory rate 15.
records.translation: バイタルサインは体温103.4、脈拍105、血圧120/80、呼吸数15。
records.back_translation: Vital signs: temperature 103.4, pulse 105, blood pressure 120/80, respiratory rate 15.

records.source: Lung exam reveals expiratory wheezing, decreased breath sounds, and egophany in the left lower lung field.
records.translation: 肺の聴診で左下肺野に呼気時喘鳴、呼吸音減弱、ヤギ音を認める。
records.back_translation: On lung auscultation, expiratory wheeze, reduced breath sounds and egophony in the left lower lung field.
